blogPosts.title: How Much Does a Bathroom Renovation Cost in Melton in 2026?
blogPosts.excerpt: Planning a bathroom renovation in Melton? Discover average costs, pricing factors and expert tips from Fine Edge to help you budget your 2026 project.
body: If you are a Melton homeowner thinking about renovating your bathroom, one of the first questions on your mind is probably: how much will it cost? The truth is, bathroom renovation costs in Melton can vary significantly depending on the size of your space, the materials you choose and the scope of work involved. As a general guide, a straightforward bathroom refresh in Melton typically starts from around $8,000 to $12,000, while a full-scale renovation with premium fixtures, custom tiling and structural changes can range from $15,000 to $30,000 or more. At Fine Edge Bathrooms and Kitchens, Steve has been helping Melton homeowners navigate these costs for years, ensuring every project delivers maximum value without cutting corners on quality or workmanship.

Several key factors influence the overall cost of a bathroom renovation in Melton. The first is the size of your bathroom - larger spaces require more materials, more tiling and more time to complete. The second is whether you are keeping your existing layout or moving plumbing and electrical connections, which adds complexity and cost. Material choices also play a huge role; Australian-made ceramic tiles, stone benchtops and premium fixtures from brands like Caroma or Villery and Boch will cost more than standard options but deliver superior longevity. Steve always recommends Melton homeowners consider the long-term value of investing in quality materials, as a well-renovated bathroom can significantly increase your property's value in the growing Melton market.

Waterproofing is one aspect of bathroom renovation that should never be overlooked, particularly in Melbourne's variable climate. In Melton, where temperatures can swing from cold, damp winters to hot, dry summers, proper waterproofing is essential to prevent costly water damage down the track. Australian Building Code requirements mandate specific waterproofing standards for wet areas, and Steve ensures every Fine Edge bathroom renovation in Melton meets or exceeds these standards. The waterproofing stage typically adds $1,000 to $2,500 to your renovation budget, but it is an investment that protects your home for decades. Cutting corners on waterproofing is one of the most common mistakes Melton homeowners make when choosing a budget renovator.

Tiling is another significant cost component in any Melton bathroom renovation. The price depends on the tile material, size and the complexity of the layout. Large-format porcelain tiles are popular in Melton homes because they create a seamless, modern look and are easier to maintain. However, intricate mosaic work or herringbone patterns will increase both material and labour costs. Steve typically quotes tiling separately to give Melton homeowners full transparency on this cost. For a standard-sized Melton bathroom, expect tiling costs to range from $2,000 to $6,000 depending on your selections. Steve can recommend trusted Melton and Melbourne suppliers who offer quality tiles at competitive prices for your renovation project.

One question Steve hears regularly from Melton homeowners is whether they should renovate their bathroom themselves to save money. While a DIY approach might seem cost-effective initially, bathroom renovations involve specialist trades - plumbing, electrical work, waterproofing and tiling - that require licensed professionals. Mistakes in any of these areas can lead to expensive rectification work, insurance issues and potential safety hazards. Steve has seen too many Melton homeowners come to him after a failed DIY attempt, paying more than they would have if they had engaged a professional from the start. A licensed carpenter and renovation specialist like Steve ensures your Melton bathroom renovation is done right the first time.

Timing your bathroom renovation can also affect costs in Melton. Many homeowners prefer to schedule renovations during the quieter winter months when tradies are more available and scheduling is more flexible. During peak spring and summer periods, demand for quality renovation specialists in Melton increases, which can extend wait times. Steve recommends booking your Melton bathroom renovation at least four to six weeks in advance, particularly if you have specific timeline requirements. Planning ahead also gives you more time to select materials, compare quotes and make informed decisions about your renovation. Contact Fine Edge today for a free consultation and detailed quote tailored to your Melton bathroom project.

Melton is experiencing significant growth, with new housing developments and existing homes undergoing renovations across the suburb. Whether you live in an established property in the Melton town centre or a newer build in Melton South or Cobblebank, a quality bathroom renovation is one of the smartest investments you can make. It improves your daily living experience and adds substantial resale value to your property. Steve and the Fine Edge team have completed bathroom renovations across Melton and its surrounding suburbs, and they understand the unique requirements of local homes. From established properties needing modern updates to contemporary builds requiring custom solutions, Fine Edge delivers bathroom renovations that Melton homeowners are proud of.

blogPosts.title: Kitchen Renovation Ideas for Melton Homes: A Complete Guide
blogPosts.excerpt: Exploring kitchen renovation ideas for your Melton home? Steve from Fine Edge shares expert tips on layouts, materials, cabinetry and budgeting for your dream kitchen.
body: The kitchen is the heart of every Melton home, and a well-planned renovation can completely transform how your family lives, cooks and entertains. Whether your current kitchen feels dated, lacks storage or simply does not work for your family's needs, a renovation by Fine Edge Bathrooms and Kitchens can deliver a space that is both beautiful and highly functional. In this guide, Steve shares his expert kitchen renovation advice specifically for Melton homeowners, drawing on over 20 years of experience in bathroom, kitchen and laundry renovations. From layout planning to material selection, we will walk you through everything you need to know to create your dream kitchen in Melton.

The first step in any kitchen renovation is understanding how you use your space. Melton families have diverse needs - some need a large, open kitchen for entertaining, while others prioritise compact, efficient layouts that maximise every centimetre. Steve recommends starting by mapping out your daily kitchen routine: where do you prepare food, where do you store appliances, how many people use the space at once? This information forms the foundation of a kitchen design that truly works. In Melton's growing market, smart kitchen design is particularly important as homes vary from established brick veneers to modern project homes in newer estates. Fine Edge tailors every kitchen renovation to your specific Melton home and lifestyle.

Cabinetry is the backbone of any kitchen renovation, and this is where Steve's carpentry expertise truly shines. With over 20 years of experience in custom joinery, Steve designs and builds cabinetry that fits your Melton kitchen perfectly. Unlike flat-pack alternatives, custom cabinetry from Fine Edge is built to last using quality Australian materials and precision construction techniques. Soft-close drawers, integrated pantry solutions and clever corner storage are just some of the features Steve can incorporate into your Melton kitchen renovation. The cabinetry stage typically represents the largest portion of your kitchen budget, so investing in quality craftsmanship from the start ensures your kitchen looks and functions beautifully for decades to come.

Benchtop selection is another critical decision in your Melton kitchen renovation. Popular options among Melton homeowners include engineered stone such as Caesarstone, natural stone like marble or granite, and durable laminate surfaces. Each material has its advantages in terms of cost, durability and aesthetics. Steve helps Melton homeowners weigh up these options based on their budget, cooking habits and desired look. For families with young children, a durable engineered stone benchtop offers an excellent balance of style and practicality. For those seeking a premium finish, natural stone delivers unmatched beauty but requires more maintenance. Whatever you choose, Fine Edge ensures your benchtop is professionally installed to withstand the demands of a busy Melton kitchen.

Lighting and splashbacks are the finishing touches that elevate a kitchen renovation from good to exceptional. In Melton, where homes can vary in natural light depending on orientation and block size, thoughtful lighting design is essential. Steve recommends a layered approach combining overhead task lighting, under-cabinet LED strips and pendant lights over island benches. For splashbacks, subway tiles remain popular in Melton kitchens, but there is a growing trend towards large-format tiles, glass panels and pressed metal splashbacks that add texture and visual interest. Steve can coordinate these specialist trades as part of your complete kitchen renovation, ensuring a seamless and stunning result for your Melton home.

The kitchen renovation process with Fine Edge is designed to be as stress-free as possible for Melton homeowners. Steve manages the entire project from initial design through to final installation, coordinating plumbers, electricians and other trades as needed. Most kitchen renovations in Melton take between three to six weeks depending on scope, and Steve provides a clear timeline at the outset so you know exactly what to expect. Throughout the renovation, Steve maintains open communication, keeping you updated on progress and any decisions that need to be made. This personalised approach is what sets Fine Edge apart from larger renovation companies that treat Melton homeowners as just another project number.

Investing in a kitchen renovation is one of the smartest decisions a Melton homeowner can make. A well-executed kitchen renovation can add significant value to your home, particularly in Melton's active property market where updated kitchens are a major selling point. But beyond financial returns, a beautiful, functional kitchen improves your daily quality of life. Imagine cooking in a space designed specifically for how your family lives, with everything within easy reach and a design that reflects your personal style. That is what Steve and the Fine Edge team deliver to Melton homeowners every day. Contact Fine Edge today to discuss your kitchen renovation and receive a free, no-obligation quote for your Melton home.

blogPosts.title: Why Melton Homeowners Are Choosing Laundry Renovations in 2026
blogPosts.excerpt: Discover why Melton homeowners are investing in laundry renovations in 2026, from custom cabinetry to smart storage solutions that transform your daily routine.
body: When Melton homeowners think about renovating, the kitchen and bathroom usually come to mind first. But there is one room that is rapidly gaining attention: the laundry. Once considered a purely utilitarian space hidden behind a closed door, the modern laundry has evolved into a highly functional area that deserves the same design attention as any other room in your Melton home. At Fine Edge Bathrooms and Kitchens, Steve has seen a significant increase in laundry renovation requests from Melton families who want to maximise space, improve functionality and create a laundry area that genuinely works for their lifestyle. Here is why laundry renovations are becoming a top priority for Melton homeowners in 2026.

One of the biggest drivers behind the laundry renovation trend in Melton is the need for better storage and organisation. Many older Melton homes were built with small, cramped laundries that offer minimal bench space and virtually no storage. This means laundry supplies end up scattered across the kitchen, cleaning products are stored in inconvenient locations and folding becomes a chore performed on the bed or dining table. A professional laundry renovation by Fine Edge transforms this neglected space into an organised hub with custom cabinetry, dedicated storage for detergents and supplies, a proper folding station and hanging space. For busy Melton families, this level of organisation saves time and reduces household stress every single day.

Space optimisation is particularly important in Melton homes where the laundry often doubles as a mudroom, pet washing station or secondary storage area. Steve has worked with many Melton homeowners who need their laundry to serve multiple purposes without feeling cluttered or chaotic. Custom cabinetry designed around your specific needs is the key to achieving this. Whether you need integrated pet washing facilities, overhead drying racks, pull-out ironing boards or built-in hampers, Steve designs and builds solutions tailored to your Melton laundry. The result is a space that works harder without feeling cramped - a common challenge in the compact laundries found in many Melton homes.

The materials you choose for your Melton laundry renovation matter more than you might think. Laundries are high-moisture environments, which means waterproof benchtops, moisture-resistant cabinetry and durable flooring are essential. Steve recommends materials like laminate or solid-surface benchtops that can handle water exposure without warping or staining. For cabinetry, moisture-resistant MDF or marine-grade materials ensure longevity in Melton's variable climate. Flooring options such as waterproof vinyl planks or porcelain tiles provide both durability and style. Steve draws on his 20 plus years of experience to recommend the right materials for your Melton laundry, ensuring your renovation looks great and performs well for years to come.

Integrating your laundry with the rest of your Melton home's design is another trend Steve is seeing more frequently. Rather than treating the laundry as an afterthought, Melton homeowners are now requesting cohesive designs that flow from their kitchen, bathroom or hallway into the laundry space. This might mean matching cabinetry styles, coordinating colour palettes or using complementary tiles and benchtops. Steve can help you achieve this seamless look, particularly if your Melton laundry is adjacent to your kitchen or bathroom. The result is a home that feels thoughtfully designed and cohesive, which adds both aesthetic appeal and property value in Melton's competitive real estate market.

The cost of a laundry renovation in Melton varies depending on the scope of work, materials selected and any structural changes required. As a guide, a straightforward laundry refresh with new cabinetry, benchtops and flooring typically starts from around $5,000 to $8,000. A more comprehensive renovation including plumbing modifications, custom joinery and premium finishes may range from $10,000 to $18,000. Steve provides detailed, transparent quotes for every Melton laundry renovation, so you know exactly what you are investing in before any work begins. He also offers flexible payment options to make your laundry renovation more accessible. Contact Fine Edge today to discuss your Melton laundry project and discover how a well-designed laundry can transform your daily routine.

blogPosts.title: Signs Your Melton Kitchen Needs a Refresh: Expert Advice from Fine Edge
blogPosts.excerpt: Is your Melton kitchen showing its age? Steve from Fine Edge shares the key signs it is time for a refresh and how to get started with your renovation.
body: Your kitchen works hard every day, and over time even the best-built spaces start to show their age. For Melton homeowners, knowing when it is time for a kitchen refresh versus a complete renovation can save both time and money. Steve from Fine Edge Bathrooms and Kitchens has over 20 years of experience helping homeowners across Melbourne, including Melton, assess their kitchen's condition and determine the best path forward. In this guide, Steve shares the key signs that your Melton kitchen may need attention, from functional issues that affect your daily routine to aesthetic concerns that diminish your home's overall appeal and value in the local property market.

One of the most obvious signs your Melton kitchen needs a refresh is outdated cabinetry. If your cabinets are showing signs of wear, have damaged hinges or simply look dated with styles from the 1990s or early 2000s, it may be time for an upgrade. In many Melton homes, especially those built in the 1980s and 1990s, kitchens were fitted with basic laminate cabinets that were never designed for long-term durability. Steve can assess your existing cabinetry and advise whether a refresh with new doors, handles and soft-close mechanisms is sufficient, or whether a complete custom cabinetry replacement would better serve your Melton kitchen. Either way, updated cabinetry transforms the look and feel of your entire space.

Lack of storage is another common complaint Steve hears from Melton homeowners. If you find yourself struggling to find space for appliances, dealing with overflowing cupboards or lacking dedicated pantry storage, your kitchen design may no longer be meeting your family's needs. Melton families are growing, and with that growth comes an increased need for organised, accessible storage. Steve specialises in designing custom storage solutions for Melton kitchens, including pull-out pantry shelves, deep drawers for pots and pans, corner carousel units and overhead cabinets that make use of every available centimetre. A storage-focused kitchen refresh can dramatically improve your daily cooking experience without the cost of a full renovation.

Worn or damaged benchtops are another clear indicator that your Melton kitchen needs attention. Chips, cracks, stains and heat marks not only look unsightly but can also harbour bacteria and compromise food safety. If your benchtop is laminate and showing significant wear, upgrading to a more durable surface such as engineered stone or solid surface can elevate your kitchen's appearance and functionality. Steve has helped numerous Melton homeowners choose benchtop materials that suit their lifestyle and budget, ensuring the replacement is both practical and visually appealing. In Melton's warm summers, a heat-resistant benchtop also provides peace of mind when placing hot pots and pans directly from the stove.

Poor lighting and an inefficient layout are often overlooked but significantly impact how you experience your Melton kitchen. If your kitchen feels dark, cramped or poorly organised, it affects everything from meal preparation to family gathering. Melton homes built in certain decades often feature kitchens with a single overhead light and a closed-off layout that separates the cook from the rest of the family. Steve can help Melton homeowners reconfigure their kitchen layout to improve workflow, add task lighting under cabinets and install pendant lights or downlights that brighten the entire space. Even minor layout adjustments can make a Melton kitchen feel significantly larger and more inviting without the expense of knocking down walls.

If your Melton kitchen is experiencing any of these issues, the next step is a professional assessment. Steve from Fine Edge Bathrooms and Kitchens offers free on-site consultations for Melton homeowners, where he will inspect your kitchen, discuss your concerns and provide honest advice on the best approach - whether that is a targeted refresh or a complete renovation. With over 20 years of experience in kitchen renovations across Melbourne, Steve has the expertise to maximise your budget and deliver a kitchen that genuinely works for your Melton lifestyle. Do not settle for a kitchen that frustrates you every day. Contact Fine Edge today and take the first step towards a kitchen you will love for years to come.
